topic_ko: 탈락한 줄 알았던 오디션이 사실은 합격이었던 반전
_note: narrative(심경 변화) — 주제/주장/빈칸 등 학술유형은 제외하고 어법·어휘·순서·삽입·요약·서술형만 작성. grammar/vocab 의 밑줄 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재.

passage: I rushed into the music room, breathing heavily after running all the way there.
The rest of the band were sitting silently with long faces, and Immy shook her head at me.
I sank into a chair, unable to speak.
I had truly believed we would make it, because our audition had been flawless.
My chest felt heavy as I asked them who had won the contest.
Holding back my tears, I waited for the answer that I dreaded.
A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy's face, and the others began cheer loudly.
It turned out that the winning band was ours, and my heart was racing with excitement.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ begin 은 목적어로 to부정사나 동명사를 취하므로 동사원형 cheer 를 바로 쓸 수 없다. began to cheer(또는 began cheering)로 고쳐야 한다. 정답 ③.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①동시동작을 나타내는 분사구문 breathing, ②the rest of the band 를 복수로 본 were sitting, ④분사구문 Holding back my tears, ⑤과거진행형 was racing 은 모두 어법상 옳다.

passage: I ran into the music room, breathing heavily after hurrying all the way there.
The rest of the band were sitting with long faces, and Immy looked up at me and shook her head.
I sank into a chair, certain that we had lost.
I had truly believed we would make it, for our audition had been flawless.
My chest felt heavy as I asked who had won, and I was holding back my tears.
She answered calmly that a band called A Happy Accident had taken the prize.
A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy's face and the others began to cheer.
Learning that the winning band was in fact ours, I was filled with sorrow and hugged them all.
My heart was racing with excitement.
vocab.explanation_ko: ⑤ 우승 밴드가 자기들이었음을 알고 서로 껴안으며 심장이 두근거렸다고 했으므로 감정은 '기쁨(joy)'이어야 한다. sorrow(슬픔)는 정반대라 문맥상 틀리다 → joy 로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①long faces(시무룩한 얼굴), ②flawless(흠 없는), ③holding back(참다), ④calmly(담담하게)는 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: I ran into the music room, breathing heavily, and the rest of the band were sitting with long faces.

blocks.A: "A band called A Happy Accident. They were quite good," she said calmly, and for a moment the room stayed silent.
blocks.B: A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy's face, and the others began to cheer. "Wait, what? That's us!" I said.
blocks.C: Immy looked up at me and shook her head, so I sank into a chair. My chest felt heavy as I asked who had won, holding back my tears.

order.explanation_ko: 시무룩한 분위기(주어진 글) 다음에 (C)에서 고개를 젓는 Immy를 보고 주저앉아 우승자를 묻고, (A)에서 그 대답으로 다른 밴드 이름이 나오며, (B)에서 미소와 환호로 그 밴드가 사실 자신들임이 드러난다. (C)-(A)-(B).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 대답은 '누가 이겼냐'는 질문(C)이 있어야 성립하고, (B)의 반전은 밴드 이름(A)이 먼저 언급되어야 "That's us!"가 의미를 갖는다.

insert.insert_sentence: I was holding back my tears.

passage_marked.text: I ran into the music room, breathing heavily, and the rest of the band were sitting with long faces.
Immy looked up at me and shook her head, so I sank into a chair.
My chest felt heavy as I asked, "So, who won?"
"A band called A Happy Accident. They were quite good," she said calmly.
A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy's face, and the others began to cheer.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 '가슴이 무거워진 채 우승자를 물었다'는 ③앞 문장의 감정을 이어받아 실망이 가장 짙은 순간을 보여 준다. 곧이어 담담한 대답(④앞)이 이어지므로 ③이 자연스럽다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①·②는 아직 결과를 묻기 전이라 눈물을 참을 이유가 약하고, ④ 이후는 이미 반전이 시작되어 실망의 묘사가 어울리지 않는다.

passage: I ran into the music room, breathing heavily.
The rest of the band were sitting with long faces, and Immy shook her head at me.
I sank into a chair, sure that our audition had failed.
My chest felt heavy as I asked who had won, holding back my tears.
She calmly named a band called A Happy Accident as the winner.
A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy's face and the others began to cheer.
The winning band was in fact our own, and the gloomy faces had been a joke because I was late.
Filled with joy, we jumped up and hugged each other while my heart raced with excitement.
summary.summary_template: Believing that the band had __(A)__ the contest, the narrator was crushed, until the members revealed that their gloomy faces were only a __(B)__ and that the band had actually won.
summary.explanation_ko: 화자는 밴드가 대회에서 (A)졌다고(lost) 믿어 낙담했지만, 시무룩한 얼굴이 늦게 온 자신을 놀리려는 (B)장난(prank)이었고 실제로는 우승했음이 밝혀진다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A) 처음에는 이겼다고 믿은 것이 아니라 졌다고 믿었으므로 won/entered 는 틀리고, (B) 착오(mistake)나 경고(warning)가 아니라 의도적인 장난(prank)이었다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 잠시 후, Immy의 얼굴에 환한 미소가 번졌고, 다른 아이들은 환호하기 시작했다.
writing.answer: A moment later, a big smile spread across Immy's face, and the others began to cheer.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간 부사구 A moment later 로 시작하고, spread across(~에 번지다), begin + to부정사(to cheer)의 어순을 지킨다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 나는 우리가 해낼 것이라고 진심으로 믿었었다.
writing.answer: I had truly believed we would make it.
writing.explanation_ko: 과거완료 had + 과거분사(believed), 시제일치로 will → would, make it 은 '해내다'.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 나는 가슴이 무거워진 채 "그래서, 누가 이겼어?"라고 물었다.
conditions: 감각동사 felt 와 형용사 heavy 를 사용할 것
writing.answer: My chest felt heavy as I asked, "So, who won?"
writing.explanation_ko: feel 은 2형식 감각동사로 보어에 형용사(heavy)를 취하고, as 는 동시성을 나타내는 접속사이다.

writing.question: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.explanation_ko: 합격 사실을 알고 난 뒤의 감정이므로 '흥분(excitement)'이며, 본문 마지막 문장에 그대로 등장한다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Immy laughed and said, "Since you were late, we decided to play a joke on you! We made it!"
writing.answer: Immy는 웃으며 "네가 늦게 와서, 우리가 너한테 장난을 치기로 했지! 우리가 해냈어!"라고 말했다.
writing.explanation_ko: Since 는 이유를 나타내는 접속사(= Because), play a joke on + 사람은 '~에게 장난을 치다', make it 은 '해내다·성공하다'.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: At first the narrator was holding back his (A)___________, but after the truth came out he was filled with (B)___________.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 처음에는 눈물(tears)을 참고 있었고, (B) 진실이 밝혀진 뒤에는 기쁨(joy)으로 가득 찼다.
